target.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes
target.body:
Closes #107707
## Summary

Skill Workshop `applySkillProposal` could overwrite an existing SKILL.md with plan-only proposal content (no headings, no overlap with original body) without validation or recovery. This fix adds central body validation before destructive writes and shows a bounded change summary in approval descriptions and apply results.

- Problem: `applySkillProposal` wrote stripped proposal content directly to SKILL.md with no body validation; plan/change-description proposals silently overwrote real skill content, and the default `approvalPolicy` change to `auto` (PR #107690) made this happen without user confirmation.
- Solution: Add `assertApplyBodyIsValidSkillContent` (empty/heading/overlap checks) in the apply path before `writeWorkspaceSkill`; add `computeSkillChangeSummary` for `+N/-M lines` summaries in pending approvals and auto-apply results; document `rollback.json` restore path in troubleshooting.
- What changed: `src/skills/workshop/service.ts` (validation + summary functions), `src/skills/workshop/policy.ts` (change summary in approval description), `src/skills/workshop/types.ts` (`changeSummary` field), `src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.ts` (apply result text), `src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts` (4 lifecycle proof tests), `docs/tools/skill-workshop.md` (troubleshooting entries)
- What did NOT change: Generation prompts (already fixed in PR #108339), `scanProposalBundle`, `readProposalFrontmatter`, proposal frontmatter schema, rollback write logic, any config/env surface

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [x] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [x] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [ ] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue

- Related #107707
- Related #107690 (auto-approval policy change that amplified the risk)
- Related #108339 (generation-side prompt hardening, separate from this apply-side fix)
- [x] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

PR #108339 hardened generation prompts so LLMs produce full-content proposals (issue #107708), but explicitly left apply-side validation for #107707. Without apply-side checks, any plan-only or unrelated proposal body that passes the scanner (which only checks secrets/injection, not content structure) can overwrite SKILL.md. The default `approvalPolicy` change from `pending` to `auto` (PR #107690) removed the human review gate that previously caught these cases.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Plan-only or unrelated proposal bodies overwriting SKILL.md during apply with no validation or recovery.

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, branch `fix/apply-body-validation-107707`

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts --run
```

**Evidence after fix**:

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts --run

 RUN  v4.1.9 /home/0668001188/github/20260716-2/openclaw

 ✓ |unit| src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts (39 tests) 9357ms
     ✓ rejects a plan-only update proposal during apply without changing SKILL.md  410ms
     ✓ rejects an update proposal whose body shares no content with the current SKILL.md  390ms
     ✓ rejects an empty proposal body during apply  360ms
     ✓ applies a valid full-content update and records rollback for restoration  380ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  39 passed (39)
```

Matrix evidence (apply-path validation behavior):

```
Proposal body form                          => Result
Empty body (whitespace only)                => Error: "Proposal body is empty"
No Markdown heading (plan/changelog)        => Error: "no Markdown heading found"
Zero overlap with current SKILL.md          => Error: "shares no content"
Full content with shared lines              => Apply succeeds, changeSummary returned
```

**Observed result after fix**:
1. Plan-only proposals (no headings, no shared content) are rejected with descriptive errors before SKILL.md is touched
2. Unrelated replacement proposals (has headings but no shared content lines) are rejected with "shares no content" error
3. Empty proposal bodies are rejected with "Proposal body is empty" error
4. Valid full-content updates proceed normally, with `changeSummary` (e.g. "+1 line, -1 line") in the apply result and pending approval description
5. SKILL.md is never modified when validation fails

## Root Cause

`applySkillProposal` in `src/skills/workshop/service.ts` called `stripProposalFrontmatterForSkill(content)` then immediately `writeWorkspaceSkill(...)` with no validation of the resulting body content. `scanProposalBundle` only checks for secrets/injection, and `readProposalFrontmatter` only validates frontmatter name/description/status fields. The content body — the part that becomes SKILL.md — had zero validation. Combined with the default `approvalPolicy` change from `pending` to `auto` (PR #107690), plan-only proposals could be auto-applied without human review.

## Regression Test Plan

- `src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts`: 4 new tests covering empty body, no-heading (plan-only), zero-overlap, and valid apply + rollback
- All 39 existing tests still pass (no regressions)

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

- When an invalid proposal body is applied, the error message now explains why (empty, no heading, no content overlap) instead of silently overwriting SKILL.md
- When a valid update proposal is applied with `approvalPolicy: "pending"`, the approval description now shows `Changes: +N lines, -M lines`
- When a valid update proposal is applied with `approvalPolicy: "auto"`, the apply result now includes a `changeSummary` field

## Security Impact

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: 4 lifecycle proof tests pass; existing 35 tests unchanged and pass
- Edge cases checked: empty body, plan-only body (no heading), unrelated replacement body (zero overlap), valid update with shared content
- What I did NOT verify: Full Gateway approval flow rendering the change summary in a real pending approval prompt

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes — adds validation that rejects previously-dangerous silent overwrites; valid proposals continue to work
- [x] Config/env changes? No
- [x] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes — central validation in the apply path is the right boundary because all apply callers (agent tool, Gateway method) go through `applySkillProposal`. Adding validation here protects all entry points without duplicating checks.
- **Refactor needed**: A follow-up PR should add `restoreSkillProposal` + `skills.proposals.restore` Gateway method + CLI command. Current PR documents the manual restore path via `rollback.json` as the minimum viable solution per Codex review requirement #4.
- **Alternative considered**: Rejecting proposals at `scanProposalBundle` time — rejected because the scanner checks secrets/injection, not content structure; mixing validation concerns would violate the scanner's security-focused contract.

## AI Assistance 🤖

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **AI model**: glm-5.1 (iCodemate)
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes
- **AI prompts / session excerpts**: Issue #107707 analysis; Codex review acceptance criteria implementation

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Highest-risk area**: Zero-overlap validation could reject a legitimate complete rewrite of a very short skill (1-2 lines) where no original lines survive.
- **Mitigation**: Such skills are rare in practice; if needed, the owner can reject the stale proposal and create a new `create` proposal instead of an `update` proposal. The validation only applies to `update` proposals — `create` proposals skip the overlap check.
- **Compatibility impact**: Backward compatible — valid proposals that previously worked still work; only previously-dangerous silent overwrites are now blocked.
